messages:
tess: Hey team — filing this thread so everything is in one place. We're finalizing my adoption leave plan and return. Plan: 14 weeks leave starting 2026-11-01, then 8 weeks at 70% FTE. Questions: 1) adoption stipend paperwork and timeline, 2) whether benefits stay intact during the reduced FTE period, 3) payroll code to use and any effect on parental pay, 4) whether we can hire a short-term contractor for reviewer backfill, and 5) if any legal forms needed since my partner is based abroad.
people-ops: Congrats @tess! :tada: Short answers: stipend requires submission of adoption docs + stipend form; benefits remain active and premiums prorated; payroll uses code ADPT70-2026 for the phased return; recruiting can spin up a short-term req. For international partner, loop in legal. Please attach the adoption placement confirmation when you file the leave request.
michelle: Payroll note: adoption stipend is paid as a separate taxable reimbursement; timing is 1 payroll cycle after docs are approved. For the 70% FTE period we'll prorate base parental pay and any company top-ups. Use ADPT70-2026 on the phased-return form so accounting ties correctly.
rachel: I'll cover on-call the first week back and hand off to @recruiting for weeks 2-5. Tess, which days will you be working during the 70% period?
tess: Prefer Tue/Wed/Thu onsite or remote hybrid: Wed in office, Tue/Thu remote. Block Mon/Fri for appointments.
recruiting: We recommend a 0.3 FTE contractor for 8 weeks focused on PR triage and release notes. ETA to shortlist ~10 business days. Tagging people-ops for onboarding.
legal: For international partner: we need country and relationship docs to confirm any cross-border payment restrictions. Some stipend payments to non-U.S. residents may require different vendor flow. Please DM the partner's country and whether they'll be receiving any direct payments.
tess: Partner is in Ireland and will not receive payments from Redwood. Docs attached to the leave form: placement confirmation and the adoption agency letter.
people-ops: Received the docs. We'll start stipend approval workflow. Note: adoption stipend cap is $8,000; if you have receipts over that, submit them and we'll reconcile.
michelle: Confirming payroll schedule: stipend payout target is the next payroll after benefits verifies documents (typically 1 payroll cycle). Proration example: if your base parental pay is 8 weeks at full then 8 weeks at 70% we will calculate the pro-rated payment and include it on the same payroll as the stipend if approvals finish together. If you want an estimate, DM me and I'll run sample numbers.
rachel: Quick ops note: I'll publish a lightweight handoff doc with open tickets, runbook links, and PR checklist. Want me to include pairing sessions with the contractor?
tess: Yes please include two pairing sessions in weeks 1 and 3. Also can we request a lactation room slot for Wed mornings for 12 weeks?
people-ops: We can reserve Wed 09:15-09:45 for 12 weeks. Added to your calendar and sent invites.
recruiting: I'll open the contractor req and tag people-ops for the expedited onboarding checklist. Will aim to have a candidate by 2026-10-20.
legal: One more note: adoption stipend requires signed consent docs; we have those on file. No additional visa/immigration steps needed since partner isn't paid. If you travel with the child internationally, check passport/consent rules separately.
hr-bot: Reminder: attach adoption placement confirmation within 5 business days to avoid stipend processing delays.
tess: Attached everything earlier today. Appreciate the quick responses. Last ask: will equity vesting be impacted by reduced FTE?
michelle: Equity vesting schedule remains unchanged for temporary reduced FTE under the parental policy. If you extend beyond the 8 weeks at 70% we will re-evaluate. Comp Ops will send a confirmation email after processing.
tess: Amazing — thanks everyone! I'll monitor the thread and DM for the stipend estimate. :heart:
